sourceTaskPrompt: Echo's RFC 9457 error handler mutates a caller-owned `*ProblemError` while applying default status, type, and title. A package-level sentinel reused across requests is therefore permanently changed and can race. Apply defaults only to response-local state, leaving the original problem unchanged. Preserve explicit fields, exposed-detail behavior, response content type, JSON output, and HEAD/no-content status handling. Add focused regression coverage that reuses the same sentinel.
